newsitem.title: USA: JMAR Industries gets $5 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: JMAR Industries gets $5 mln contract.

text.p: JMAR Industries Inc said Tuesday it has received an order for additional disk head inspection workstations valued at more than $5 million from a major U.S. computer and hard disk drive manufacturer.
The order is the single largest equipment sale in the company's nine-year history, JMAR said.

The firm purchase order consists of $3.2 million, 50 percent of which is payable immediately, for delivery and installation of a combination of automated and manually operated workstations. It also includes a letter of intent for additional units valued in excess of $1.9 million.

All of the workstation units are to be delivered within the next 12 months. JMAR said in a statement that the customer also agreed to pay substantial penalties if it fails to fund the order for the additional units before the end of March 1997.
